summary.text: Shaina Smith is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 41, and a business owner.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026, and faces Republican Michael Riley in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Shaina Smith was born in Massachusetts.
She earned a high school diploma from Killingly High School and a bachelor's degree from Southern Connecticut State University in 2007.
